explanation: The execution is faulty because provenance record identities were not preserved across the upstream-to-downstream handoff. Job 2 received needs with record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, but evidence_sources with record_id values s01 through s08. As a result, downstream priority rows all have upstream_rank 0 instead of the demand-descending provenance ranks. The supplied source localizes this to job_1 assemble_provenance, which constructs evidence_sources with record_id set from source_id rather than the original record_id.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance and demand-descending rank order, then ranking unsupported needs while preserving upstream provenance order.
Job 2 input needs contain record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, while Job 2 input evidence_sources contain record_id values s01 through s08.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, demonstrating the provenance handoff could not be matched by record_id.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record identity with the source identity.
